author: /root/m07_recovery_ack_packet
intent: Close candidate recovery capture ACK request/response and issuer-proof mapping without changing effective formal ACK.

architecture.hexagonal: Trusted M07 observation → proposed M04 captured-recovery ACK input boundary → sole DocumentOwner → existing trusted proof lookup abstractions ← M07 index/M05 transfer issuer adapters
architecture.dependency: M07 observer → M04 owner boundary; M04 depends on proof abstractions; no UI/native/domain bypass. No new API approval.
architecture.ownership: M04 owns document/live state and formal/recovery baselines. M07 owns immutable attempt/index observations. M05 owns materials/pins/roots.
architecture.mutation: Only M04 matching owner generation/session may ACK exact immutable capture. Baseline update is conditional monotonic by captured revision, never live content overwrite.
architecture.transaction: Resolve handles/proofs outside index/catalog leases, recheck owner fence at M04 baseline commit. Owner baseline + replay terminal response must be atomic in future design; native atomicity unproved.

boundary.caller: Only trusted orchestration with pre-resolved M04 capture capability; UI supplies no trusted body/proof/state. No unauthenticated caller data admitted.
boundary.lookup: Fixture stands for existing issuer-owned lookup: exact (issuer, receipt_id) for M07 index and M05 root transfer; compare full context, capture and body. ReceiptRef hashes are commitments, not authorization. Never accept caller boolean verified labels.
boundary.no_registry: immutable-proof.json is a documentary fixture, never a proposed document registry; proof/provider integration PH-G2..4 remains separate pending adoption.

s1_limit: Accepted S1 recovery_state.rs consumes HOST-supplied Published; it has no timer, filesystem, codec, fingerprint computation, pinning, capture/provider authentication or M04 ACK integration. This proposal changes none of those facts.

hash.digest: SHA256 canonical UTF8 entire admitted request recursively, including protocol/issuer/role/ordinal/context/body. Same canonical rules as CXv3; distinct protocol prevents cross-purpose replay.
hash.key: Proposed M04 owner replay store identity + workflow_id + operation_id + authenticated issuer/owner binding; physical durable store/provider pending Owner.
hash.replay: Exact retained terminal digest returns exact response, not another mutation. Changed valid body same key ReplayConflict. InFlight InProgress. Lost durable proof UnverifiedOutcome; no automatic retry/release/ACK.
hash.details: Request body commits capture owner/capability, attempt/snapshot/context, fingerprint profile+hash, immutable ordered material versions, payload raw, index prior/new raw+transaction+target, index/transfer refs. Resolve before freeze; no enrichment after hash.

mapping.fingerprint: Reuse original SGA-RECOVERY-FP-v1 definition includes format/semantic/material versions/bindings. Do not replace by payload/index raw or formal semantic hash.
mapping.index: index_receipt.evidence_digest hashes FULL immutable index evidence; context_digest hashes full WorkflowContext. Match target/prior/new raw/transaction/payload/materials/attempt/snapshot/fingerprint exactly.
mapping.transfer: transfer_receipt.evidence_digest hashes FULL M05 immutable transfer record; request_digest must hash entire frozen transfer-recovery request. Match issuer, role, workflow, operation, context, pin, source receipt IDs, materials, roots, expected+committed generation and native store/target identity.
mapping.distinction: M05 external_proof.raw_digest=index committed raw; projection_digest=index FULL evidence hash; recovery fingerprint remains independent. source_receipt_ids bind Held and index refs.

contracts: Never reuse formal-only ack body/role implicitly
Only M04 mutates recovery baseline; no formal baseline change
Captured R ACK may succeed with live R+1 while live remains dirty
Late R after acknowledged R+1 returns Superseded; no backward baseline
M05 root Deferred retains LocalIntegrityReady, not Published; no ACK/release
Missing or Unknown issuer evidence => UnverifiedOutcome, no automatic retry
No catalog/index lease held during M04 callback

owner_options.option: Adopt distinct protocol and ack-recovery role/body/receipt mapping, replay lifecycle and atomic owner mutation
Instead explicitly version effective transition schema with formal/recovery discriminated union, role/hash migration and full compatibility analysis; not performed
